about: Player's Handbook (2024): mechanics only, in askdnd's own words, checked against Brett's offline copy; never book text

adds.name: Bardic Inspiration
adds.why: the creature can add the die to a D20 Test it fails (2024: after seeing it fail)

adds.name: Blessed Strikes
adds.why: Cleric: once a turn, extra radiant damage on a hit with a cantrip or weapon attack

adds.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
adds.why: Oath of Conquest (Xanathar's) and War Domain: +10 to an attack roll once you've seen it (Brett's Roll Audit comment, Nov 10: it's chosen with the to-hit, not after the hit)

adds.name: Deflect Attack
adds.why: Monk: reduce an attack's damage by 1d10 + Dexterity + Monk level

entries.name: Deflect Attack: Redirect Attack
entries.why: Monk: the target saves against your Monk DC or takes two rolls of your Martial Arts die + Dexterity, the attack's type; the reduction is Deflect Attacks'

rolls.name: Redirect Attack
rolls.note: the same damage type as the attack you deflected

entries.name: Land’s Aid: Damage
entries.why: Circle of the Land: a Con save in a 10-ft sphere, half on a success; 3d6 at Druid level 10, 4d6 at 14

entries.name: Land’s Aid: Heal
entries.why: Circle of the Land: one creature in the area regains the same dice

adds.name: Sneak Attack
adds.why: Rogue: once a turn, extra damage on a hit with a Finesse or ranged weapon, with Advantage or an ally beside the target

adds.name: Tactical Mind
adds.why: Fighter: on a failed ability check, spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10 (kept if it still fails)

entries.name: Uncanny Metabolism
entries.why: Monk: regain a roll of your Martial Arts die + your Monk level (and your Focus Points)

entries.name: Wild Shape: Feral Forms
entries.why: the dice are the forms' own (their stat blocks: Wild Shape, app/wild_shape.py), not a roll of the Druid's

entries.name: Wild Shape: Guardian Forms
entries.why: the dice are the forms' own (their stat blocks: Wild Shape, app/wild_shape.py), not a roll of the Druid's

entries.name: Find Steed
entries.why: the steed attacks with its own stat block (app/summons.py), not the caster's dice

entries.name: Mind Sliver
entries.why: not in the SRD; checked against the 2024 Player's Handbook

rolls.name: Mind Sliver
rolls.note: On a failure it also subtracts 1d4 from its next save before the end of your next turn

entries.name: Thorn Whip
entries.why: not in the SRD; checked against the 2024 Player's Handbook

rolls.name: Thorn Whip
rolls.note: A Large or smaller target can be pulled up to 10 ft closer

entries.name: Toll the Dead
entries.why: 1d8, or 1d12 if the target is missing Hit Points; not in the SRD, checked against the 2024 Player's Handbook

entries.name: Word of Radiance
entries.why: not in the SRD; checked against the 2024 Player's Handbook
